gateway.title: Welcome to NiniApp
gateway.subtitle: How do you want to use NiniApp?
gateway.iosButton: What if I have an iPhone or iPad?
gateway.iosSteps:
APK files cannot be installed on Apple devices. Instead, the web version can be pinned to the home screen and behaves like a regular application:

1. Open this page in Safari.
2. Tap the Share button: the square with an upward arrow in the browser bar.
3. Select the "Add to Home Screen" option and confirm.

From that moment on, NiniApp will appear with its icon on your home screen.
gateway.iosNote: Direct download is only compatible with Android devices. iOS users must use the web version.

help.title: Help
help.intro: This section explains how each part of the application works.
help.eventsBody: Any member can create events from the Calendar; administrators can additionally mark them as special. Each member votes their attendance with YES, NO or DECIDING. Voting closes a few hours before the event starts (the number of hours is set by its creator). Changing a vote after voting has closed subtracts 5 commitment points. Once the event is over, its creator validates attendance: having voted YES and not showing up subtracts 15 points. Past events remain in the history for one month before being deleted.
help.commitmentBody: The commitment percentage (from 0 to 100) reflects each member's reliability with the group's plans. It decreases when receiving penalties and recovers gradually: 0.5 points for each day without fault.
help.counterBody: The group counter records whatever the group decides to count; it is configured by the administrator. The group streak increases when at least one person contributes each day; if nobody contributes on a given day, the streak returns to zero, although the accumulated total is always preserved. Each member also has a personal streak. From the fourth contribution on the same day it is mandatory to attach a proof photo; these photos are deleted after 24 hours.
help.copipointsBody: Copipoints are the group's internal currency: all members start with 100. Only drivers can add or subtract them, from the Drivers Zone. Each member's balance can be checked in the Ranking.
help.driversBody: The administrator designates drivers from the group settings. Each driver has their own car (model, color and seats) which they can edit in the Drivers Zone, their exclusive panel.
help.carsBody: When creating an event, cars can be enabled: those of the group's drivers or temporary cars valid only for that event. Only members who voted YES can take a seat, and it is released automatically if they change their vote.
help.pokeBody: The Poke feature allows you to get another member's attention from their profile. At most one poke can be sent to each person every 24 hours. Receiving pokes can be disabled from the Profile.
help.groupsBody: Each user can belong to a maximum of three groups and switch the active group from the Profile. Joining a group requires its ID and password, available in the group settings. If the administrator leaves the group, the role passes to the member they designate.
help.suggestionsBody: The suggestion box allows you to send improvement proposals directly to the application's developer from the Profile. Suggestions can be sent anonymously if desired.
help.iosBody: The Android application (APK) cannot be installed on Apple devices; the web version must be used instead. To have it as a regular application, open niniapp.org in Safari, tap the Share button (the square with an upward arrow in the browser bar) and select the "Add to Home Screen" option. The application will be pinned with its icon on the home screen.
